deadline.value: The MS/PhD application deadline for fall is January 1 (the priority funding date), with all materials due January 15.
deadline.quote: MS/PHD Priority funding deadline September 15 January 1 January 15

gre_general.value: GRE is required for PhD applicants without a previous degree from a US university.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (required for MS and PhD applicants who do not have a previous degree from a university in the United States

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A CEE faculty member must agree to be the PhD advisor before admission.
supervisor.quote: For admission, a student must have a CEE faculty member agree to be his/her PhD advisor.

funding.value: Graduate teaching assistantships are decided by the admissions committee, and funding is limited.
funding.quote: Graduate Teaching Assistantships (GTA): GTA positions are determined by the Admissions Committee and may be available to students admitted for fall term.

entry_route.value: The PhD requires a master's degree in engineering, science or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: Master of Science degree in an engineering field, science, or closely related area.

notes: Third-party sites give different deadlines; only the department's table is quoted.
